desc:
This was an extremely popular joseki that has been rendered mostly obsolete by AI judgements.

It has two ladder variations, one with Black <A:N14> and another that bends around to the star point on the right (<X:Q10>) and begins with Black <B:M13>.

This joseki played a large part in Lee Sedol's [famous ladder game.](https://senseis.xmp.net/?LeeSedolHongChangSikLadderGame)
